profile.bio: I am an Android Developer Trainee at HeroApps, following an OJT internship. I contribute Kotlin and Jetpack Compose features within existing team codebases: LoL browsing, search, purchases, ads and release work; MLBB Firebase sign-in/sign-up and Figma-guided UI; and EarnPH shared Kotlin event joining, QR validation and client-side polygon checks. I collaborate with senior developers, backend developers, project managers and QA testers. I use Gemini and, more recently, Codex as development aids; the project descriptions distinguish my contributions from existing team code and reused patterns.
